title: 第七章 会诸侯

content_zh:
“正当如此，诸侯人马纷杂，正需有一位盟主指挥。”河内太守王匡附和道。
袁绍看了一眼帐内诸侯，目光停留在吕布身上缓缓说道：“绍以为，吕将军率军抵挡董贼，勇武无人可挡，当为盟主，统领兵马讨伐老贼。”
“哼，吕布有何能耐，匹夫之勇而已。”袁术不屑的冷哼道。
吕布瞥了袁术一眼，拱手道：“布才疏学浅，不足以担当重任，袁家四世三公，门生故吏遍天下，在下认为本初当为盟主，方能服众。”
“你……”袁术的表情不是很好看，他才是嫡子，下一任家主的人选，而袁绍不过是庶出，却被吕布推举。
“正是如此，本初理当为诸侯盟主。”曹操附声道，吕布所言正是他心中所想。
“承蒙诸位抬爱，可在下身无寸功，岂敢坐盟主之位。”袁绍将目光从吕布身上移开，随后推辞道。
在众人的再三推举下，袁绍坐上了盟主之位，对于各路诸侯的表现也记在了心上，吕布的示好他也是看在眼里。
“既然诸位推举我为盟主，诸位就要听从调遣，同为讨伐董卓老贼，切勿以强弱计较，作战中有功必赏，有过必罚。”歃血为盟之后，袁绍端坐在上首位置冷声道。
见无人反对，袁绍继续说道：“后将军袁术总督粮草，确保各路兵马粮草不缺。”
“诺。”袁术喜形于色，虽然没做上盟主，但总督粮草可是个美差，其中油水多多，看谁不顺眼就能整谁，一向看袁绍不顺眼的袁术第一次觉得袁绍是那么的可爱。
“不知何人愿为先锋？”袁绍环视众人。
“坚愿为前部。”孙坚出列道。
“文台勇武，可当此重任。”袁绍点头道：“其余诸侯整备兵马，前往汜水关。”
“敢问这位就是名震天下的吕布吕将军吧？在下北平太守公孙瓒。”
“久仰久仰，原来是公孙太守。”吕布急忙抱拳回道，没想到自己成了名震天下的将军，怪不得选举盟主的时候袁绍看向自己的目光有些不善呢。
“吕将军，军情紧急，告辞，来日必宴请将军。”
“不急不急，公孙太守身后的便是刘关张三兄弟吧？”吕布在公孙瓒身后的两人身上嗅到了一丝危险的气息，出声问道。
“哦，吕将军认得他们？”公孙瓒好奇道。
“如雷贯耳，刘关张桃园结义，剿黄巾，立下赫赫战功，何人不知啊。”吕布叹道。

“还是吕将军好眼力，不似某些人，狗眼看人低。”张飞哈哈大笑道。
张飞的嗓门本来就大，这一嗓子，让刚出营帐的袁术闹了个黑脸，冷哼一声，扬长而去。
公孙瓒见此，脸色有些发苦，有了这一出，袁术肯定将账算在他的头上。
“哈哈，想必这位是翼德兄弟吧，果然是快意恩仇，来日我们一醉方休。”吕布笑道。
“求之不得，听说吕将军武功盖世，俺还要讨教一番呢。”张飞越看越觉得吕布顺眼，殊不知历史上就是他第一个骂吕布是三姓家奴的。
“翼德不可放肆。”刘备上前抱拳道：“三弟有得罪的地方还望吕将军见谅。”
“无妨无妨，武人之间哪有那么多的规矩。”吕布摆手道，与张飞这样的猛将交手，肯定有很多收获，他还求之不得呢。
与几人告别之后，吕布快步追上孙坚“文台兄且慢走。”
“哦，不知吕将军有何见教？”孙坚疑问道。
“孙将军此次攻打汜水关，一定要确保粮草充足，而且此次恐怕会有人不甘心而去抢功。”吕布提醒道。
“这是当然，正所谓三军未动粮草先行，本将军身为大军先锋，又会有何人抢功？吕将军多虑了。”孙坚的语气有些不爽。
“孙将军……”吕布欲言又止，虽然说历史是这么演的，万一不是那剧情，岂不是白白得罪了孙坚和袁术。
“吕将军，在下还有要事，来日再叙。”
“唉。”吕布叹息一声，暗想自己什么时候变得这么伤春悲秋了，每个人都有自己的命，东汉末年的人那么多，还指望自己一个个去提醒吗？还是先做好自己的吧，更何况连义父丁原都没能改变命运。
“将军，那袁术真不是东西，我们并州军与董卓老贼厮杀了无数场，他竟然如此辱骂将军，若不是高将军拦着，我早就动手了。”回到大营后，曹性破口大骂，连一向闷声不语的高顺也是面色铁青。

content_en:
"Just as this is the case, there are many people among the princes, and they need an alliance leader to command." Wang Kuang, the governor of Hanoi, agreed.
Yuan Shao glanced at the princes in the tent, his eyes rested on Lu Bu and said slowly: "Shao thought that General Lu led the army to resist the Dong thief, and his bravery was unstoppable. He should be the leader of the alliance and lead the troops to attack the old thief."
"Hmph, what's Lu Bu's ability? He's just an ordinary man's bravery." Yuan Shu snorted disdainfully.
Lu Bu glanced at Yuan Shu, cupped his hands and said, "Bu's talents are sparse and his knowledge is low, and he is not qualified to take on important responsibilities. The fourth and third princes of the Yuan family have disciples and former officials all over the world. I believe that I should be the leader of the alliance in order to serve the people."
"You..." Yuan Shu's expression was not very good. He was the legitimate son and the candidate to be the next head of the family, while Yuan Shao was just a concubine, but he was recommended by Lu Bu.
"That's right. I should be the leader of the alliance of princes at first." Cao Cao echoed, and what Lu Bu said was exactly what he thought.
"Thank you for your support, but I have no merit in my lower body. How dare I take the position of leader." Yuan Shao turned his eyes away from Lu Bu and then declined.
With the repeated recommendation of everyone, Yuan Shao took the position of alliance leader. He also kept in mind the performance of various princes, and he also saw Lu Bu's goodwill.
"Since you have elected me as the leader of the alliance, you must obey the orders and work together to defeat Dong Zhuo, the old thief. Don't compare your strengths and weaknesses. In the battle, meritorious service will be rewarded, and mistakes will be punished." After joining the alliance with blood, Yuan Shao sat at the top and said coldly.
Seeing that no one objected, Yuan Shao continued: "The queen general Yuan Shu is the governor of food and grass to ensure that there is no shortage of food and grass for the troops and horses."
"No." Yuan Shu beamed with joy. Although he did not become the leader of the alliance, the governor's job was a good one. There was a lot of oil and water in it, and he could punish anyone he didn't like. Yuan Shu, who had always disliked Yuan Shao, felt that Yuan Shao was so cute for the first time.
"I wonder who is willing to be a pioneer?" Yuan Shao looked around at everyone.
"Jian is willing to be at the front." Sun Jian came out and said.
"Wentai is brave enough to take on this important task." Yuan Shao nodded and said: "The other princes prepared their troops and headed for Sishui Pass."
"May I ask if this is the world-famous General Lv Bulu? I am Gongsun Zan, the prefect of Peiping."
"I have admired you for a long time, it turns out it is Grand Administrator Gongsun." Lu Bu hurriedly replied with his fists clasped. He did not expect that he would become a world-famous general. No wonder Yuan Shao looked at him in a somewhat unkind way when he was electing the leader of the alliance.
"General Lu, the military situation is urgent. Please take your leave. I will entertain the general at a banquet tomorrow."
"Don't be anxious, don't be anxious. Behind Grand Administrator Gongsun are the three brothers Liu, Guan, and Zhang, right?" Lu Bu smelled a hint of danger on the two people behind Gongsun Zan and asked aloud.
"Oh, General Lu recognizes them?" Gongsun Zan asked curiously.
"Like thunder piercing the ears, Liu Guan and Zhang Taoyuan became sworn brothers, suppressed the Yellow Turbans, and made great military exploits. Who doesn't know about it?" Lu Bu sighed.
"General Lu still has good eyesight, unlike some people who look down on others." Zhang Fei laughed.
Zhang Fei's voice was already loud, but this voice made Yuan Shu, who had just left the camp, make a bad face, snorted coldly, and walked away.
When Gongsun Zan saw this, his face turned bitter. With this incident, Yuan Shu would definitely put the blame on him.
"Haha, I guess this is brother Yide. It's really a grudge. Let's get drunk the next day." Lu Bu said with a smile.
"It's not what I asked for. I heard that General Lu's martial arts skills are world-class, so I still want to ask for advice." The more Zhang Fei looked at him, the more he liked Lu Bu. Little did he know that he was the first in history to scold Lu Bu for being a slave of the third surname.
"Yide must not be arrogant." Liu Bei stepped forward and clasped his fists and said, "Third brother, I hope General Lu will forgive me if I have offended you."
"It doesn't matter, there aren't so many rules among warriors." Lu Bu waved his hands. Fighting against a fierce general like Zhang Fei would definitely yield a lot, and he couldn't ask for more.
After saying goodbye to a few people, Lu Bu quickly caught up with Sun Jian, "Brother Wentai, please walk slowly."
"Oh, I wonder if General Lu has any advice?" Sun Jian asked.
"General Sun's attackWhen attacking Sishui Pass, we must ensure that there is sufficient food and grass, and I am afraid there will be people who are unwilling to take the credit this time. " Lu Bu reminded.
"Of course, as the saying goes, the three armies go ahead without using food and grass. As the general, I am the vanguard of the army, who will take the credit? General Lu is worried too much. "Sun Jian's tone was a little unhappy.
"General Sun..." Lu Bu hesitated. Although history played out this way, if it weren't for that plot, wouldn't he have offended Sun Jian and Yuan Shu in vain.
"General Lu, I still have important matters to discuss. I'll discuss them later. "
"well. "Lu Bu sighed, thinking to himself when did he become so sad for spring and autumn? Everyone has his own destiny. There are so many people in the late Eastern Han Dynasty, do you expect yourself to remind them one by one? You should do your own thing first, not to mention that even the adoptive father Ding Yuan could not change his fate.
"General, that Yuan Shu is really nothing. Our Bingzhou army has fought countless battles with Dong Zhuo, the old thief, and he insulted the general like this. If General Gao hadn't stopped him, I would have taken action long ago. "After returning to the camp, Cao Xing cursed loudly, and even Gao Shun, who had always been silent, looked livid.
